question: Where’s the closest museum encountered when moving toward Black Point Inn, Scarborough, ME from Mount Washington Boat Terminal, Wolfeboro, NH?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mount Washington Boat Terminal%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wolfeboro%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NH%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Black Point Inn%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Scarborough%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%ME%' LIMIT 1 ), -- Calculate the azimuth (bearing in degrees) from the start point to the end point target_azimuth AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geom, e.geom)) AS azimuth FROM start_point s, end_point e ), -- Find all museums and calculate their distance and azimuth from the start point museums_data AS ( SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.geometry AS geom, ST_Distance(s.geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) AS distance_from_start, degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geom, p.geometry)) AS museum_azimuth FROM pois p, start_point s WHERE p.tourism = 'museum' ) -- Filter museums that are within a certain angular range (e.g., 45 degrees) of the target direction -- and then select the closest one to the start point among them. SELECT md.id, md.poi_name FROM museums_data md, target_azimuth ta WHERE -- Calculate the shortest angular difference between the museum's azimuth and the target azimuth LEAST( ABS(md.museum_azimuth - ta.azimuth), 360 - ABS(md.museum_azimuth - ta.azimuth) ) <= 45 -- Within a 45-degree cone (22.5 degrees on either side) of the target direction ORDER BY md.distance_from_start ASC LIMIT 1;
